domain: Guest registration and reporting for short-term lets

rules.statement: Anyone carrying on or intermediating in lodging activity, expressly including private individuals letting short-term tourist dwellings through portals, must report the guest and transaction data in Anexo I to the Secretaria de Estado de Seguridad within 24 hours of the start of the service, and keep a documentary register.
rules.notes: A private foreign owner letting short term IS a sujeto obligado. Anexo I includes payment data: payment type, card or IBAN, date of payment. Communication obligations took effect from 2 January 2023 under disposicion final 3. The widely cited 2 December 2024 date is UNVERIFIED and appears to be an administrative deferral of enforcement rather than a change in the law; RD 933/2021 has never been amended.
